answer: Each claim must ride the public tide through a trellis grown from its own verified jobs, each rung a peer check tied to a different ledger line, and pay 55 POA burned to pass it. A copied trellis sends the wrong ripple through the rungs — peers read the ripple signature against the ledger, the rung breaks, and the claim sinks with its 55 POA burned. Cost doubles per claim from one operator, so 10 clones cost 56,265 POA; a trellis is rooted in its own ledger line and cannot be transplanted across identities.
